ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, 
 no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, 
 f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name 
 and field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING IS
 cnt number :=0;
 al_id alert;
 al_button number;

begin

 select count(*)
 into cnt
 from valid_city_state
 where upper(city) like '%'||:ctrl_blk.city||'%'
 and zip = nvl(:ctrl_blk.zip,zip)
 and state = nvl(:ctrl_blk.state,state)
 and county = nvl(:ctrl_blk.county, county);

 if cnt = 0 then
 al_id := find_alert('CITY_ALERT');
 set_alert_property(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'No records found for this criteria');
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 set_block_property('VALID_CITY_STATE',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'upper(city) like ''%''||:ctrl_blk.city||''%'' 
 and zip = nvl(:ctrl_blk.zip,zip) 
 and state = nvl(:ctrl_blk.state,state)
 and county like ''%''||:ctrl_blk.county||''%'' ');

-- go_block('VALID_CITY_STATE');
 execute_query;
 
 if :valid_city_state.usps_id is not null then
 enable_disable_item('ctrl_blk.pb_update', 'E');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2, param_value VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 show_error('11071');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donors.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_usps_id', TEXT_PARAMETER , param_value); 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 redisplay;
 --pitss synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ENABLE_DISABLE_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE enable_disable_item(p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 IF p_mode = 'E' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 END IF; 
 ELSIF p_mode = 'D' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end if;
END;
